top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 151 RFAI and Form 99 filings in the three-day window were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The scripts found 151 FEC RFAI and Form 99 filings received since October 15, 2026, but every one was already covered in a prior edition, so there are no new RFAI letters, Form 99 correspondence, terminations or voided and negative transactions to report in this edition.

The only item from the deterministic checks is a late October Quarterly report: Rep. Emanuel Cleaver (D-MO-5)'s campaign filed on 10/16/2026, one day late. It appears in the Deadline Watch section below.

sections.headline: Nothing new in Deadline Watch after removing items already reported
paragraphs: 1 sitting member' campaigns filed the October Quarterly (Q3) report late.

footer.coverage_window: FEC RFAI (FRQ) and Form 99 filings received October 15, 2026 onward, checked as of the PM edition on Sunday, October 18, 2026.
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.
